entries.privacy: Installing does not create an account or send anything about you. The app is stored by your browser, and the storage manager shows how much space it uses.
faq: Do I have to install it?
No. Everything works in a normal browser tab. Installing makes it open faster and work offline more reliably.
Which one should I pick?
Everything, if you use both studios. Pick one studio to keep the installed app smaller. On the home screen they are named LocalEditor, LE Design and LE PDF.
Does Firefox on a computer work?
Firefox on a computer cannot install web apps. The site still works offline in a tab after your first visit.
How do I uninstall it?
Remove it like any other app from your home screen or your browser’s app settings. Clear its storage in the storage manager first if you want.

faq: Will clearing storage delete my designs?
Clearing saved work does. Clearing fonts or graphics only removes downloads, which come back when you use them again.
Why would the browser delete my work?
Browsers can clear site data when the device is low on space. Asking for persistent storage makes that less likely, and saving a project file keeps a copy you control.

faq: Why is it labelled Beta?
Results depend on the photo. It works best on one clear subject that stands out from its background. Crowded scenes, fine hair and glass can need touching up with the brush.
Which option should I choose?

Start with the one the panel recommends. Quick suits products with clean edges, More detail suits busy edges and thin parts, and the people option suits portraits and groups. The larger options on capable computers suit hair, plants and busy photos.
How big are the downloads?

Quick is about 5 MB, and More detail and People and portraits are about 44 MB each. The larger options are about 109 to 481 MB, and the panel tells you before it fetches one. Each downloads once and then works offline. In Settings you can choose to be asked before every download.
What if it cannot find a subject?
It says so and changes nothing. You can try a more detailed option, or cut the subject out by hand with the brush.
Does it change my original photo?
No. The cut-out is a mask on top of the photo, so you can switch back to the original at any time.

entries.title: PDF redaction
entries.headline: Redact a PDF {for real, then check it.}
entries.metaTitle: Redact PDFs properly in your browser, with a verify pass
entries.description: Black out text and pictures so they are removed from the file, not just covered, then re-open the saved copy to check. On your device, nothing uploaded.
entries.tagline: Removes what is under the boxes, then verifies
entries.summary: Draw boxes over what must go, or find sensitive data first. Redact and verify makes a new copy with the covered content removed, then opens that copy again and checks that nothing from under the boxes is left. Your original is not changed.
does: Draw boxes on any page, or add the matches from Find sensitive data
By default, pages with boxes are rebuilt as a picture of the page, so nothing under a box can be copied or recovered; their text can no longer be selected
Optional: keep other text selectable where a box covers only plain text
A verify report: the saved file is opened again and searched, and each box is checked to be solid black
Choose picture quality (Standard, High or Best) and an optional label such as REDACTED
steps: Open the PDF, choose Protect, then Hide information for good.
Draw boxes over what to hide, or use Find sensitive data to mark it.
Choose Redact and verify, read the report, and download the new copy.
entries.privacy: The file is redacted and checked on this device and never uploaded. Your original stays as it is; the redacted copy is a new file.
faq: Why not just draw a black box?
A box drawn on top can be moved or deleted, and the text under it can still be copied. Redaction removes that content from the file.
What does “verified” check?

The saved copy is opened again. It checks that the page count is unchanged, that no text is left under a box, that the hidden words are not stored anywhere in the file, that every box is solid black and that no earlier version is inside. If a check fails it says so and tells you not to send the file. It does not replace reading the result yourself.
Why can I not select text on a redacted page?

Pages with boxes become pictures by default, so nothing under a box can be recovered. Pages without boxes stay as they were. The option to keep other text selectable keeps text only where a box covers plain text.
Can a redaction be undone after saving?
No. Keep your original if you might need it. A PDF locked with a password has to be unlocked first.

entries.privacy: The check runs on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
faq: Does removing this change the pages?
No. It removes data around the pages, not the content you see. The check reads the file as you opened it, not later edits in the studio.
Is every hidden item found?
The common ones are. An unusual file may hold something the check does not recognise, so read important files yourself too.
What about a password-protected PDF?
The details can be read in some cases, but they can only be removed once the password has been taken off the file.

faq: Is this a virus scanner?
No. It reports risky features of a PDF, such as scripts and automatic actions. It does not replace security software.
Does it open or run the file?
No. The file is read as data. Nothing inside it is executed.
What does the safe copy change?
It removes active content and leaves out attached files. The pages look the same.

Does it redact?

Does it work on a password-protected PDF?

Which languages?
English is included. The panel lists any other languages this copy of the app has. One language is read per run.
Does it change my pages?
The page picture stays as it is. The open document is replaced by its searchable copy as one undo step, so you can undo it.
Can it help find sensitive data in scans?
Yes. Find sensitive data can read the scanned pages first and marks those matches for you to check.

faq: Does it change my original photo?
No. Every adjustment is a setting stored with the photo layer. Switch it off, reset it or remove it and the original comes back.
Can I use LUT files made elsewhere?
Yes, .cube files, both 1D and 3D. A file that is over 16 MB, damaged or uses unknown entries is refused with a message instead of being half read.
Can I grade only part of a photo?
Yes. Each adjustment can have a mask: a brush, a gradient, or a range of brightness or colour. An adjustment layer grades everything beneath it.
Does it work on my phone?

It opens on a phone with a compact layout, but Expert mode is designed for a larger screen. The effects need WebGL 2, which most current phones and computers have; the Device check page shows what your browser supports.

faq: How do I make a photo look like film?
Stack Film grain, Halation and Fade, then add a light leak or a vignette if you like. Each has its own sliders and amount, so you can keep the look subtle.
Can I blur the background of a photo?

Yes. Lens blur and the other blur effects can be limited to part of the picture with a mask. Depth blur blurs by distance instead, and needs a depth map: choose the Light tool and its Depth map button to make one on your device, after a one-off download of about 16 MB from this site. A depth map is an estimate, so edges such as hair can need touching up with a mask.
Will the export match what I see?
Yes. The export uses the same settings as the preview and is drawn from your original photo, not from the preview.
Do effects slow my device down?
Heavy effects switch to a lighter preview while you drag a slider and sharpen when you let go. A long stack on an older phone can still be slow, so switch effects off to find the heavy one.

entries.privacy: Photos are edited by your browser on this device, using your graphics hardware. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account, and nothing is added to what you export.
faq: Does the photo need a transparent background?
Yes. Shadows and reflections follow the outline of the subject, so the product needs a cut-out or a transparent background. The background remover on this site makes one.
How do I place the shadow?

Each shadow has an anchor, the point where the product meets the ground, which you can drag on the picture. Put Refine edge first, then reflections, then shadows, so that a reflection does not reflect the shadow.
Are the results realistic?

A shadow is drawn from the outline of the product as if it stood on a flat floor. That suits packshots and simple scenes. It is not a 3D render, so a product with a complicated base, or a busy scene, needs adjusting by eye.
Can a big photo be slow?
Cast shadows and reflections are the most demanding effects. On large pictures they are drawn in tiles and can take a few seconds on a modest device.

faq: What is a mask?
A mask says where an effect or a layer shows. White shows it, black hides it, and grey is in between. You can paint one with a brush, draw a gradient, or select by brightness or colour.
Does Match colour get the match exactly?
It measures the average colour and spread of the subject and the background and moves one towards the other. That gives a close start. Fine-tune by eye.
Do depth and subject masks need anything extra?

A subject mask comes from the background remover. A depth mask needs a depth map: choose the Light tool and its Depth map button to make one on your device, after a one-off download of about 16 MB from this site.
Is the original photo kept?
Yes. Layers, masks and blend modes are settings in your design, so you can change or remove any of them.

faq: Will it make skin look fake?
Strong smoothing can. Every tool has an amount slider, and frequency separation keeps the fine texture, so modest settings look natural. Use the before and after view to check.
Does it find every face?
No. Face finding is an estimate, and a small, turned or covered face can be missed. A mask lets you limit an effect to where you want it.
Does it change my original photo?
No. Healing, cloning and dodge and burn are stored as a layer over the untouched photo, and the other tools are settings.
How does the Patch tool work?
Draw around the area, then drag the outline onto a clean area. It is stored as one step you can undo, over the untouched photo.
Can I paint on a phone?
Yes, with one finger to paint and two to zoom, but Expert mode is designed for a larger screen.

faq: Can it be undone?
Yes. Strokes are kept as settings, so Restore all removes them, and undo steps back stroke by stroke.
Is there a limit to how far it moves things?
Yes. Displacement is capped at a share of the photo’s long side, which keeps results from tearing. Big changes need several small ones.
Does face-aware liquify work on every face?
Only on faces it finds. A small, turned or covered face can be missed, and a very strong slider setting looks unnatural, so use the before and after view.
Does it work on my phone?

It opens on a phone with a compact layout, but Expert mode is designed for a larger screen. The effects need WebGL 2, which most current phones and computers have; the Device check page shows what your browser supports.

Phone DNG files open with the site’s own reader. For camera formats, the optional decoder covers many makes, including Canon, Nikon, Sony and Fujifilm, but not every camera or every newer model. If a file will not open, the app says so and leaves it untouched.
Is it the full-resolution RAW?

Previews use a reduced working copy (up to 4096 pixels on the long side on a computer, less on smaller devices). Export decodes the original again at full size where the device can manage it, up to about 48 megapixels on a computer, and otherwise exports from the working copy.
Are there limits on size?
The original RAW is kept inside a design only up to the project’s 80 MB limit. A larger file still opens and can be edited here, but the design says the original is not stored in it.
Does it have lens profiles?
No lens database is included, so lens corrections are manual sliders.

faq: Does it work for handheld shots?
It handles small shifts and small rotations, up to about three degrees. A larger move, or a step sideways, can fail; a tripod, or exposure fusion with ghost removal turned high, works better then.
How big can the merged picture be?
The merge is limited to about 8 megapixels on a computer, 5 on a mid-range device and 3 on an older one, because it needs a lot of memory. Larger photos are reduced for the merge.
Can I use RAW brackets?
Yes. RAW frames are merged before white balance, so the result can be developed afterwards. Mixing RAW and JPEG frames in one merge is not allowed.
Is this the same as the HDR look on one photo?
No. A single photo has less to merge. The tone mapping control can still give a single RAW photo an HDR-style look.

faq: How good is the depth map?

It is a small model’s estimate of relative distance, not a measurement. It separates a subject from the ground and the background well and gives faces and large objects a believable roundness. It is weaker on hair, thin things and flat walls, so keep light and relief settings moderate.
How big is the download and how long does it take?
The depth model is about 16 MB and downloads once from this site. After that a map takes a few seconds on a computer and longer on a phone. It needs a fair amount of memory while it runs.
Will it fix a badly lit photo?
It can add and shift light and soften light that is already there. It cannot remove hard shadows or bring back what was lost in dark or blown-out areas.
Does it work on my phone?

It opens on a phone with a compact layout, but Expert mode is designed for a larger screen. The effects need WebGL 2, which most current phones and computers have; the Device check page shows what your browser supports.

faq: Can a visitor change my design?
No. The viewer is read-only. The open button gives them their own copy to edit, and your original stays as it is.
Do photos show?
Not from a template link, which leaves photos out: they show as empty slots. A design file kept on the same site shows its pictures when they sit next to it as relative paths.
Can a design run code in the viewer?
No. A design is data. It goes through the same reader and safety checks as the studio and is drawn on a canvas. Text from it is never added to the page as HTML.
Why does the open button show an address?
A frame without pop-up permission cannot open a new tab, so the viewer shows the address to copy instead. The copied embed code includes the permission.

faq: What is in a brand file?

A name, colours with roles, fonts by role, logos, spacing, tone words, do and don't lines, and two rules: whether pure black and white are allowed beside the palette, and the contrast ratio text must reach.
Does the studio check my design against it?
The studio checks a design that carries its brand inline. A design that names the file by path is checked by the command line, the MCP server and CI, because a browser cannot read a file by path.
How big can it be?
Up to 2 MB, with at most 40 colours and 8 logos. Embedded logos are PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF up to 256 KB each. SVG logos are not accepted.

The agent sees only the open design: not your saved designs, not stock photo keys, and only files you pick. It can use a picture from the web only after you allow that website. Your agent is a separate program; what it sends to its own provider is between you and that provider.
faq: Who turns it on?
You do. The agent cannot press the buttons that allow agent mode, or the ones that pause, stop or take over. Those belong to you.
Can an agent run code in my browser through this?
No. Changes are plain data, checked by the same gate as a design file. Anything with scripts or HTML is refused, and a batch of changes is applied completely or not at all.
What if my agent can only open links?
It can send a link that carries its changes. You see what will change and must press Apply changes before anything happens.
What can it make?
Pages, text, shapes, icons, photo slots, collages, quick makers, recipes and Expert mode effects with their masks.

Agent mode is for working with a person who watches in an open tab. The command line is for fast work that nobody needs to watch. Both use the same operations.

Node 20 or later and a Chromium-based browser. The doctor command checks the setup.

Every family is under an open licence (SIL Open Font Licence or Apache 2.0), which allows use in your own work. The licence texts are kept with each family, and the licences page lists them.
How much do they download?

Nothing at first. A family downloads when you use it, only the parts of it your text needs, and most are small. Saving a whole collection for offline use is bigger, and the storage manager shows the size.
Which languages are covered?
Latin, Cyrillic, Greek and Vietnamese, plus several Indian scripts, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai. A typeface that lacks a letter borrows it from a matching fallback.
Do the fonts work in PDFs?
Yes, in text you add in the PDF studio. Some scripts that need complex shaping, such as Devanagari and Bengali, can fall back to a standard font in a saved PDF.

Up to 5,000 in one run on a computer, 2,000 on a recent phone or tablet and 500 on older devices. It makes one at a time, so memory use stays level, and you can pause or cancel.
Which files can I bring?
Cells pasted from any spreadsheet, CSV and TSV files up to 50 MB, and Excel files up to 25 MB. The first row is read as the column names.
What if a name is too long for its box?
Each field can shrink to fit, wrap or be cut with an ellipsis. Rows that are still too long at the smallest size are listed before anything is created, so you can fix them.

Yes. Print sheets places them on A4 or Letter at the size you give in millimetres, with cut marks, as one PDF.
Can an AI agent use it?

faq: How do I print both sides so they line up?

Choose A4 or US Letter under Print sheets. You get a sheet of fronts and a sheet of backs with the cards in mirrored places. Print the fronts, put the paper back in and print the backs. What are bleed and the safe area?

Bleed is 3 mm of background beyond the cut line (0.125 in for the 3.5 × 2 in size), so a cut that is slightly off leaves no white edge. The card page includes it: an 85 × 55 mm card is a 91 × 61 mm page. Text stays at least 5 mm inside the cut line.

A scan has no text to compare, so the list of word changes is empty and the picture view does the work. Make the scans searchable first if you want their words compared.
Does it notice text that only moved?
No. Words are compared in reading order, so text that only moved to another line or page is not reported as a change. The picture view shows moves.
Does it show who changed the file?
No. It compares the two files you give it, not their history.
Is it a legal comparison?
It is a review aid. It can miss a change that is only in a picture or in a font, so read important documents yourself too.

faq: How big can a pack be?
Up to 3,000 pages in one pack.
Are my original files changed?
No. The pack is a new file.
What if a file has a password?
Unlock it first with the password tool, then add it to the pack.
What are Bates numbers?
A running reference number on every page, often used for legal documents, that continues across files.

faq: Is a stamp a signature?
No. A stamp is a picture of words with your name and date. For signing use the Sign tool. Whether either counts as binding depends on where you are and what you sign, and we cannot give legal advice.
Can I stamp every page?
Yes. Choose initials, the date or a signature, and apply it to every page or only the pages you select.
Does the comment summary include highlights?
It lists comments, notes and highlights, each with its page.

faq: Can a workflow file run code?
No. It is data: a named list of steps from a fixed set. A file with anything else is refused when you open it.
Where are my workflows kept?
In this browser, on this device. Export one to keep a copy or to send it to someone.
What do I get back?
One file when there is one result, or one zip when there are several. Files run one by one unless a step, such as merge, combines them.

entries.metaTitle: File fingerprint receipt: check a copy is unchanged
entries.description: Make a fingerprint and a one-page receipt with a QR code so anyone can check a copy is byte for byte the same file. Checked on your device.
entries.tagline: A code anyone can use to check a copy is unchanged
entries.summary: A fingerprint is a 64-character code worked out from every byte of a file. Make one for any file, print or send a one-page receipt with a QR code, and anyone can use the check page to see whether their copy matches.
does: A SHA-256 fingerprint of any file, with its size and page count
A one-page receipt PDF with a QR code, and a picture card
A check link that carries the fingerprint after the #, which browsers never send to a server
Optionally, a copy with the receipt as its last page, or the fingerprint in its details
steps: Choose the file, or use the one you have open.
Copy the fingerprint or download the receipt.
Anyone can open the check page, drop in their copy and compare.
entries.privacy: The fingerprint is worked out by your browser on this device and the file is not uploaded. The check page does the same: the file never leaves the device that checks it.
faq: What does a matching fingerprint show?
That a copy is byte for byte the same file as when the receipt was made.
What does it not show?
It does not show who made the file or when it was first created. Any change, even re-saving the file, gives a different fingerprint.
Is it a digital signature?
No. A fingerprint proves a copy is unchanged. It does not prove who made it.

faq: Does it guess the right field?
It matches field names and hints to your details, and shows each choice. It can get one wrong, so check every field before you save.
Can I keep details for more than one person?
Yes. You can save more than one set, for yourself, a partner or a company, and choose which to use.
How do I delete them?
In My details, or by clearing saved work in the storage manager.

faq: Is it accounting software?
No. It makes documents. It does not track payments, send reminders or file taxes.
Does it work out tax for me?
It adds up the tax type and rates you choose. It does not know your obligations, so check the totals and the tax wording with your adviser.
Where is my client list kept?
In this browser on this device. You can export it as a file, import it elsewhere, or erase it.
Can I turn a PDF into a spreadsheet instead?
Yes, the same panel has a tool for extracting tables from a PDF.

faq: How accurate is it?
It depends on the PDF. Tables with clear columns and rules work well. Merged cells, tables without clear columns and pictures of tables can come out wrong, so always check the numbers.
Does it work on scans?
Not directly. A scan is a picture with no text positions. Make it searchable first, then extract.
Which spreadsheet apps open the result?
Any that opens .xlsx or CSV files.
